title: Notification regarding Single Bench matters of Hon'ble the Chief Justice to be listed on 5th October, 2026 will be taken up on the same before Hon'ble Justice A Guneshwar Sharma.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 5th October, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Single Bench matters of Hon'ble The Chief Justice to be listed on 05-10-
2026 will be taken up on the same day before the Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.
Guneshwar Sharma for fixing dates, extension of interim orders as well as for taking up
urgent matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/w7/328 +b' Imphal, the 5th October, 2026
